title: 第90章 泪水口水并流第89章 单灵根天才啊
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
这句话说完之后，江小白隐约能听到电话里窸窸窣窣的动静，应该是他们村支书起床穿衣服的声音。
“儿子，你刚刚说的是真的吗？”
江小白爸妈不可置信的问道，这段时间两老冲浪了许多关于修真的新闻，知道无论是哪种属性的单一灵根都是万里挑一的好资质。
“我刚刚引气入体的时候只能吸纳木灵根入体，应该是这样没错，不过具体的还得等支书到，看能不能有更准确的检测方法。”
“如果真是这样，那我们家真是升天了啊！”
“单一灵根，可比考上清大、京大还要光宗耀祖啊！”
老两口喜不自胜。
村支书赶到江小白家的时候，已经把江小白疑似单一木灵根的消息上报。
上面早就下了文件，要求他们基层随时注意着自己辖区里的人，如果发现好苗子就一定要上报国家。
村支书的消息被紧急上报，很快就到达了梁江手里。
“先派人把人接去修炼者管理处。”
江小白一家连夜被接走，等村民们听说时，他家里已经人去楼空了。
全民灵根觉醒后，好苗子开始冒头，国家采取的方法一般都是取得了本人的同意后，将人接到各省市修炼者管理处。
同时有关部门会开始对好苗子进行政审，政审没问题后，这些人将会被送到修炼者基地，进行更加专业的培养。
政审是很重要的一个环节，东国渴求人才，却不会将对国家有异心的人放入核心的位置，也不会花费资源培养这种人。
李婉收到老家退回的快递后，看到快递里的千里二式时是又惊喜又烦忧。
惊喜的是老家的专家们太厉害了，竟然在这么快的时间就把二式创造出来了，烦忧的是，自己对于怎么突破剑术瓶颈还毫无头绪。
她这次寄快递的信里也提到了这个问题，希望下次再寄快递的时候，专家们的解答能给她提供一个思路。
迷香阵更是意外之喜，在修真界，时时刻刻都充满着危险，谁也不知道意外和明天谁先到来。
有了这个阵盘，她保命的手段就又多了一重，老家还附上了详细的使用说明和创造步骤，并表示希望下次寄快递的时候，李婉能反馈一下使用感受。

这个肯定是没问题的，修仙六艺中，李婉目前最感兴趣的就是法阵和炼器，无关什么热爱不热爱的，她纯粹是觉得这两者最适合她。
修真界法阵无处不在，如果自己能学会布阵解阵，那么不仅可以提升自己的综合战斗力。
在遇见和法阵相关困局之时也有可以破局的手段，不会像瓮中之鳖一样被困其中。
炼器则也是自身需要，她一直坚信，只有自己和自己才是真正的心意相通，只有自己才明白自己想要的是什么。
她若是精通炼器之法，就可以自行锻炼紫霞，而不会像如今这一般，因实力和钱力不够而畏手畏脚。
符咒和丹药都是对修士实力很有加成的手艺，但是在李婉这里，需求度就比较低。
毕竟她身后站着一个国家，等以后东国发展起来了，她想要什么丹药符咒都可以有，完全不需要她自己动手。
但是法阵和炼器不一样，她被困的时候东国的专家们没办法钻到修仙界来研究各处细节帮助她破阵，东国就算掌握了炼器也没办法通过快递给她寄送过来。
没办法依靠老家的地方，只能靠她自己努力。
不过这些都还是后话，她现在得连买合适心法的贡献点都还没有赚到，法阵和炼器这些离她都还太远了。
李婉目前穷得快要啃土，都打算没滋没味靠着辟谷丹过日子了，没想到老家竟然这么贴心，给她寄了这么一大兜子灵食做的食物。
包装还都采用了仿古的式样，这样就算她在外人眼前拿出，也不会引来试探。
口水和泪水同时从嘴角流下来。
content_en:
After saying this, Jiang Xiaobai could vaguely hear rustling sounds on the phone, which should be the sound of their village party secretary getting up and getting dressed.
"Son, is what you just said true?"
Jiang Xiaobai's parents asked in disbelief. During this period, they had surfed a lot of news about cultivation, and knew that no matter what attribute a single spiritual root was, it was a good qualification.
"When I first introduced the Qi into my body, I could only absorb the wood spirit roots into my body. This should be true, but we have to wait for the branch secretary to arrive to see if there is a more accurate detection method."
"If this is really the case, then our family has really ascended to heaven!"
"With a single spiritual root, one can be more glorious than being admitted to Tsinghua University or Beijing University!"
The old couple was overjoyed.
When the village party secretary rushed to Jiang Xiaobai's house, he had already reported the news that Jiang Xiaobai was suspected of having a single wood spirit root.
The higher-ups have already issued a document, requiring their grassroots to pay attention to the people in their jurisdiction at all times, and if they find any good seeds, they must report them to the country.
The news from the village party secretary was reported urgently and soon reached Liang Jiang.
"First send someone to take the person to the practitioner management office."
Jiang Xiaobai's family was picked up overnight. By the time the villagers heard about it, his house was already empty.
After the spiritual roots of the whole people are awakened, good seedlings begin to appear. The method adopted by the state is generally to obtain the consent of the person and then take the person to the practitioner management office of each province and city.
At the same time, the relevant departments will begin the political review of the good seedlings. After the political review shows no problems, these people will be sent to the cultivator base for more professional training.
Political review is a very important link. Dongguo is thirsty for talents, but it will not put people who have dissent towards the country in a core position, nor will it spend resources to train such people.
After Li Wan received the courier returned from her hometown, she was surprised and worried when she saw Senli Ershiki in the courier.
What surprised me was that the experts in my hometown were so good that they created the second style in such a short time. What was worrying was that I still had no idea how to break through the bottleneck in swordsmanship.
She also mentioned this issue in the letter she sent this time. She hopes that the experts’ answers can provide her with an idea next time she sends a courier.
The Fragrance Array is an unexpected surprise. In the world of cultivation, there is always danger. No one knows the accident or who will come first tomorrow.
With this array plate, she has one more way to save her life. She also attached detailed instructions for use and creation steps, and expressed the hope that Li Wan could give feedback on her experience when sending express delivery next time.
There is definitely no problem with this. Among the Six Arts of Immortal Cultivation, Li Wan is currently most interested in magic circles and weapon refining. It doesn't matter whether she loves them or not. She simply feels that these two are the most suitable for her.
Magical formations are everywhere in the world of cultivation. If you can learn to set up and remove formations, you can not only improve your overall combat effectiveness.
When encountering difficulties related to the magic circle, there are ways to break it, so you won't be trapped like a turtle in a urn.
Refining weapons is also her own need. She has always believed that only she and herself are truly connected, and only she knows what she wants.
If she was proficient in the art of refining weapons, she could train Zixia on her own, instead of being as timid as she is now because of lack of strength and money.
Talismans and elixirs are both crafts that greatly increase a monk's strength, but in Li Wan's case, the demand for them is relatively low.
After all, there is a country standing behind her. When Dongguo develops in the future, she can have whatever elixirs and spells she wants without having to do it herself.
But the magic circle is different from the weapon refining. When she was trapped, Dongguo's experts could not go to the world of immortality to study every detail to help her break the formation. Even if Dongguo mastered the weapon refining, they could not send it to her by express delivery.
There is no way to rely on her hometown, so she can only rely on her own efforts.
But these are all things for later, sheNow she has not even earned the contribution points to buy suitable mental techniques, and magic circles and weapon refining are still too far away from her.
Li Wan is now so poor that she is almost gnawing dirt, and she plans to live a boring life relying on Bigu Pills. She didn't expect that her hometown would be so considerate and send her such a large bag of food made from spiritual food.
The packaging also adopts an antique style, so that even if she takes it out in front of outsiders, it will not attract temptation.
Drool and tears flowed from the corners of his mouth at the same time.
